T-0124.entry_clause: A later amendment may pre-register a rule on the basis of this arm
T-0124.fresh_clause: This contract is never rewritten in place, and no amendment layers it. A change of any kind, including one a review requires, is a new successor contract under a new EXP id that states every rule once. This is the only revision rule of this contract (F-PREC reserved_topics).
T-0124.run_time_situation: After approval, an operator files AMD-NEW citing EXP-AUXIN-bafa2e and pre-registers a cut-off from the null arm. T-0124 licenses that amendment route; F-REV forbids any amendment layering this contract and requires a new EXP id. F-PREC reserved_topics makes F-REV decide and says the surviving conflict is still a draft defect. Forward-looking "may pre-register" is not mere history of the held stack.

T-0162.run_time_situation: A typed-span recipe and a referenced record disagree on a tolerance. T-0162 under R1 selects the typed source-file entries as governing; F-PREC says this contract file is the only governing text and reserved_topics cover what is governing text. Two precedence rules.

T-0636.entry_clause: Pre-registration of every cut-off rests on the sha256 binding of all four governing layers before any value is seen (change.D8_custody and custody_additions below)
T-0636.fread_note: R3 maps "governing text(s)/hash(es)" to this contract and successor_contract_sha256, and says a count (four) is provenance. That does not erase the operative sentence that pre-registration RESTS ON a sha256 binding of layers named by change.D8_custody — an incorporation-style binding. R7 says incorporates hashes are unread by gates; T-0636 is not phrased as a field reference to incorporates but as a pre-registration precondition.
T-0636.run_time_situation: Cut-off pre-registration is challenged: under T-0636 it depends on four-layer sha256 binding; under F-CUSTODY only successor_contract_sha256 binds. Outcomes differ on whether missing held-layer hashes block pre-registration.

custody_scope.scope_text: Custody binds this contract file and the transcluded spans at their source commit, and nothing else. It binds no file of EXP-AUXIN-7e2e3d.
custody_scope.literal_reading: Custody binds this contract file and the transcluded spans at their source commit, and nothing else. Under reserved_topics, F-CUSTODY is the only custody rule. If T-0019/T-0097/T-0144/T-0146/T-0362/T-0364/T-0387/T-0412/T-0557 are custody rules, they decide nothing. The draft never defines the term "custody" so as to decide which stated entries are displaced. Two readings: (A) only contract-file+span custody — those entries remain as non-custody protocol content; (B) any hash/snapshot/dirty binding is custody — they are displaced. Run-time differs on staged-source digest mismatch (T-0019/T-0364) if classified as custody under (B) vs active under (A).
